name: com.boxerbook/boxing
title: Boxerbook
description: Boxing data: schedule, results, records, rankings; win probability and odds for fight models.

tools.name: boxing_schedule
tools.description: Upcoming professional boxing cards worldwide, grouped by card: date, start_utc (card start in UTC), venue, promoter, broadcasters by region, and each bout with both records going in, division, scheduled rounds, title, Boxerbook forecast (win probability) and market odds consensus when known; each card and bout with its boxerbook.com url. Answers "is there boxing tonight", "who is fighting this weekend", "what boxing is on" and "what time does the card start", asked in any language. when=today also keeps last night's cards that started under 6 hours ago. At most 60 bouts per answer, whole days first: a longer window comes back truncated with next_arguments (from_date) for the rest. Pass lang matching the user's language (en, es, ru or ja) so the page links match it.

when.description: today (and cards still running from last night), tonight, weekend (Fri-Sun) or 30d

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country of the bout, e.g. GB, US, MX

division.description: division code (hea, wel, w_fea) or name (heavyweight, women's featherweight)

from_date.description: skip the cards before this date (YYYY-MM-DD, UTC): the next page of a truncated answer

skip.description: bouts of the first day to pass over: set by next_arguments when one day is longer than a page

lang.description: the user's language: en (default), es, ru or ja; the boxerbook.com page links of the answer follow it (a page without a translation keeps its English link)

tools.name: boxing_results
tools.description: Completed professional bouts of the last N days (N calendar days ending today: 1 = today, 2 = last night and today, up to 14), newest first: winner, method, round, time, both records going in, the sources of each result and the boxerbook.com url of each bout. Answers "who won last night", "results this weekend" and "did A beat B", asked in any language. At most 60 bouts per answer, whole days first: a longer window comes back truncated with next_arguments (before_date) for the older days. Pass lang matching the user's language (en, es, ru or ja) so the page links match it.

days.description: number of days ending today (default 2: last night and today)

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country of the bout, e.g. GB, US, MX

division.description: division code (hea, wel, w_fea) or name (heavyweight, women's featherweight)

before_date.description: keep only the bouts before this date (YYYY-MM-DD, UTC): the next page of a truncated answer

skip.description: bouts of the first day to pass over: set by next_arguments when one day is longer than a page

lang.description: the user's language: en (default), es, ru or ja; the boxerbook.com page links of the answer follow it (a page without a translation keeps its English link)

tools.name: boxer
tools.description: One boxer's card by name, slug or Boxerbook id: country, division, record (W-L-D, KOs), stance, height, reach, birth year, nickname, next fight, last result, Boxerbook rating and, when known, the record as market favourite and underdog. A name returns the best match of the site search; other_matches lists the next ones when the name is shared. Pass lang matching the user's language (en, es, ru or ja) so the page links match it.

query.description: a boxer's name, slug (giorgio-visioli) or Boxerbook id

lang.description: the user's language: en (default), es, ru or ja; the boxerbook.com page links of the answer follow it (a page without a translation keeps its English link)

tools.name: next_fight
tools.description: A boxer's next scheduled bout (by name, slug or id): date, start_utc (card start in UTC), opponent, venue, broadcasters, Boxerbook forecast and market consensus when known, and the bout's boxerbook.com url. Answers "when does X fight next", "what time is X's fight" and "where can I watch X", asked in any language. next_fight is null when none is on record (last_result is then the latest bout). Pass lang matching the user's language (en, es, ru or ja) so the page links match it.

query.description: a boxer's name, slug (giorgio-visioli) or Boxerbook id

lang.description: the user's language: en (default), es, ru or ja; the boxerbook.com page links of the answer follow it (a page without a translation keeps its English link)

tools.name: bout
tools.description: One bout in full by Boxerbook bout id, or by two boxers (two surnames, e.g. "Fury vs Joshua"): both boxers with records going in, status, result (winner, method, round, time), start_utc, venue, card, broadcasters, sources, the referee and each judge's scorecard (totals per side), the weigh-in (weight per side, missed weight), fight-week facts, the punch figures quoted on the broadcast (thrown, landed, connect %, jabs, power punches; each with its source video at the second it was said), and when known the Boxerbook forecast (win probability of side a) with its signals per side (age, layoff, last five, KO rate, rating mu and rd with its 12-month trend, home, height, reach, stance) and the market odds consensus (no-vig, number of books, opening line): the features of a fight model or a pre-fight analysis, one bout per call. Answers "have A and B ever fought", "head to head" and "when is A vs B", asked in any language: by names it returns their scheduled bout (else their latest) with head_to_head, and when they never met head_to_head alone says so, with each side's record, last fights and next bout. Pass lang matching the user's language (en, es, ru or ja) so the page links match it.

id.description: Boxerbook bout id (the id of a bout in any Boxerbook answer, or the number in a boxerbook.com/bouts/<id>/<slug> url)

query.description: instead of id: two boxers as "A vs B", two surnames, e.g. "Fury vs Joshua"

lang.description: the user's language: en (default), es, ru or ja; the boxerbook.com page links of the answer follow it (a page without a translation keeps its English link)

tools.name: where_to_watch
tools.description: Where to watch a fight and when it starts: the broadcasters (platform, region, link) of a bout or of a whole card, with the card start time in UTC and the boxerbook.com url of the bout or card; or, with platform (e.g. "DAZN", "ProBox TV"), what is on that platform: its upcoming cards and those of the last 12 months. Answers "where can I watch A vs B", "what channel is the fight on" and "what time does it start", asked in any language. Give bout_id, event_id, query (two boxers "A vs B", or one boxer for the next bout) or platform. An empty list means none is on record yet. hub_url is the site's «Where to watch boxing this week» page. Pass lang matching the user's language (en, es, ru or ja) so the page links match it.

query.description: instead of an id: two boxers as "A vs B" (their scheduled bout, else their latest), or one boxer by name (the next bout on record)

platform.description: instead of an id: a broadcast or streaming platform by name, e.g. DAZN, ESPN+, ProBox TV, BXNG TV

lang.description: the user's language: en (default), es, ru or ja; the boxerbook.com page links of the answer follow it (a page without a translation keeps its English link)

tools.name: rankings
tools.description: The top 15 of a division: the Boxerbook rating (default) or the latest list of a publisher (WBC, WBA, IBF, WBO, The Ring, TBRB), with records. Division by code (hea, wel, w_fea) or name (heavyweight, women's flyweight). Pound for pound: division p4p (or "pound for pound", pfp) gives the Boxerbook P4P top 25 of men, w_p4p (or "women's p4p") the top 15 of women, ranked by the Boxerbook rating (mu − 2·rd measured against the elite of the boxer's division; active within 18 months, 10+ bouts, 2+ quality wins in 36 months); only Boxerbook has a P4P list, no publisher's is stored. Pass lang matching the user's language (en, es, ru or ja) so the page links match it.

division.description: division code (hea, wel, w_fea) or name (heavyweight, women's featherweight)

publisher.description: boxerbook (the Boxerbook rating), wbc, wba, ibf, wbo, ring, tbrb or wban (WBAN World Ratings, women only)

lang.description: the user's language: en (default), es, ru or ja; the boxerbook.com page links of the answer follow it (a page without a translation keeps its English link)

tools.name: gyms_near
tools.description: Boxing gyms and boxing clubs near a city, a ZIP or postal code, or the user's location: name, address, distance, the gym's own phone and website, Google Maps rating with its number of reviews, the programs its website names (kids / youth, women, boxing fitness, amateur, pro), federation club, notable boxers, a short description when one is written, and the boxerbook.com page of each gym and of its city. Answers "boxing gym near me", "where can I train boxing in Austin", "boxing classes for kids in Brooklyn", "best boxing gyms in Toronto", "boxing clubs in London" (the UK capital; London, Ontario is country CA) and "is there a boxing club near 10115", asked in any language. Give place (a city such as "Brooklyn", "Austin, TX" or "Manchester", a ZIP or postal code, a state or region, or a gym's name), or lat and lon when the user's location is known; need keeps the gyms with kids classes, women's classes, boxing fitness or competition boxing. A city lists its gyms with the most complete listings and the best-reviewed first, then the nearest around it; a point or a postal code lists them nearest first within radius_km. At most 20 gyms. The directory covers the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, Germany, France and Switzerland (about 13,000 gyms); elsewhere the answer is empty and says so. Pass lang matching the user's language (en, es, ru or ja) so the page links match it.

place.description: a city ("Brooklyn", "Austin, TX", "Toronto"), a ZIP or postal code ("11201", "M5V 2T6", "SW1A 1AA", "10115"), a state or region, or a gym's name; leave it out to search around lat and lon

lat.description: the user's latitude, when known and no place is named (used for this answer only, never stored)

radius_km.description: how far around the point, the postal code or the city centre to look, in km (10 mi = 16 km)

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country to keep to when a city name exists in several countries: US, CA, GB (UK), DE, FR or CH

need.description: only gyms with kids or youth classes (kids), women's classes (women), boxing fitness classes (fitness) or amateur / pro boxing (competition)

lang.description: the user's language: en (default), es, ru or ja; the boxerbook.com page links of the answer follow it (a page without a translation keeps its English link)

tools.name: search_boxers
tools.description: Find boxers by name (at most 20), best match first: id, slug, name, country, division, record, url. Lists the boxers who share a name or a close spelling. Pass lang matching the user's language (en, es, ru or ja) so the page links match it.

q.description: a name or part of it

lang.description: the user's language: en (default), es, ru or ja; the boxerbook.com page links of the answer follow it (a page without a translation keeps its English link)

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search the whole catalog with one query: boxers by name, bouts and head to head by two surnames, e.g. "Fury vs Joshua" (when they never met, head_to_head says so with both records and last fights), their cards, and divisions ("heavyweight rankings"); an id such as bout:123 is looked up directly. Each hit has a document id, a title and its boxerbook.com url. No match returns an empty list. Pass lang matching the user's language (en, es, ru or ja) so the page links match it.

query.description: what to look for: a boxer, two boxers ("Fury vs Joshua"), a division

lang.description: the user's language: en (default), es, ru or ja; the boxerbook.com page links of the answer follow it (a page without a translation keeps its English link)

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: The full document for a Boxerbook document id: a boxer card, a bout (records, result, broadcasters, forecast, market, sources), a card with its bouts, or a division's rankings, as Markdown text with metadata. An unknown id returns an error. Pass lang matching the user's language (en, es, ru or ja) so the page links match it.

id.description: a document id: boxer:<id>, bout:<id>, event:<id> or rankings:<DIV>

lang.description: the user's language: en (default), es, ru or ja; the boxerbook.com page links of the answer follow it (a page without a translation keeps its English link)
